alerts.title: NH 766 forest stretch night travel restriction
alerts.detail: Through-traffic across the Bandipur forest stretch is restricted 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM daily. Plan Mysuru trips by day.
alerts.author: MISTROVA desk

alerts.title: Chembra Peak trek — check before you go
alerts.detail: Permits are issued by the Forest Department at Meppadi and treks may be suspended in heavy rain or mist.
alerts.author: MISTROVA desk
